notes.title: Back to School Event & New DLC are here!
notes.content:
Hey there, Puzzle fans


The joyful summer holiday season will soon be over, and many of us will return to school to learn new things, explore the world and hang out with our friends. It is also a great opportunity to relax with some brain-stimulating games, such as... The Pane Puzzle! 


The occasion to celebrate is double! 🥳
Would you like to hear even more exciting news? We got you! In addition to the mentioned Back to School Celebration, from now on you can also enjoy a completely new The Pane Puzzle DLC - Extra Levels 3! Challenge yourself with dozens of new pictures, move, turn and arrange varied shapes and do your best to recreate images presented in the varied, fun levels. Care to give them a shot?


Join us in the Steam Back to School Games Celebration[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174311/5f9aaf17c539d7fdb1bcaa24462f03e977c33a06.png"]



And what better time to jump into the game than today's awesome Steam event? Don’t miss our Back to School Celebration and expand your game library with new awesome titles such as Cipheur, the Pane Puzzle and many more! Keep an eye out for special discounts and waste no time - the event only lasts until September 1st. 



Thanks to these titles, you will provide your precious gray matter with a proper workout and a huge dose of relaxation and fulfillment - just perfect before getting back to school! Think, restore shapes, combine, decipher coded messages and be smart - all this with Error 300 games 👇


Check out the Error 300 games taking part in the event[hr][/hr]
The Pane Puzzle - now 30% Off

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192950/The_Pane_Puzzle/"][/dynamiclink]

Cipheur 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469820/Cipheur/"][/dynamiclink]

Have a great week, everyone!

notes.title: And We Bring You.. Some Extra Achievements!
notes.content:
Our first update to Cipheur have landed:

- Added the Nightmare mode and made some changes to the Hard (since people complained some quotes were too short with the previous Hard)
- Also added a tutorial text to explain you can actually close the congratulations popup to make a screenshot if you so wish.
- Finally, introduced achievements for the completion of the free packs (no, we don't plan to add achievements for the paid packs)


Also
- Fixed the double quote in the Videogame Quotes.
- Fixed the Korean language description.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/ec723063eab0041d23860aab1a3cadabe448e96e.png

notes.title: Tangram Collection Update
notes.content:
🧩Tangram Collection was updated!🧩

We know it's somewhat overdue, but the long-promised update for Tangram Collection finally landed with a number of key changes:

🧩 All the shapes and puzzle pieces were redrawn from scratch to ensure they fit properly.
🧩 The interface issues (like rotate button not working correctly) were fixed.
🧩 The game now has proper settings allowing.
🧩 Japanese language support was added.
🧩 Achievements were added.

And it's still completely free!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3182240/Tangram_Collection/

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/556adf9c3261a774834361e32b2d87f44d3a1257.png
